consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly agree that the 1989-10-09 show at Hampton Coliseum is one of the best of the era, highlighted by the long-awaited return of 'Dark Star.' The performance is noted for its tightness and energy, particularly in the second set, which features standout jams and emotional moments.
